Class ChaosDispatcher

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.core.ChaosDispatcher
@Internal public final class ChaosDispatcher extends Object
The hot-path dispatch of the chaos runtime: the entry points the instrumentation layer calls through the bootstrap bridge (see BootstrapDispatcher), one class per domain — ThreadDispatch, ExecutorDispatch, MethodDispatch, ClockDispatch, RuntimeDispatch, NetworkDispatch, DnsDispatch, FileDispatch, ProcessDispatch, ClientDispatch — over one shared DispatchEngine. Constructed by ChaosControlPlaneImpl.

Thread safety

All methods are fully thread-safe.

API stability

Not part of the stable API. This class is public because it is called from the instrumentation classloader bridge and from benchmarks, not because its method surface is frozen. The stable public surface of the chaos-agent is com.macstab.chaos.jvm.api.ChaosControlPlane; bind to that interface instead. The @Internal marker signals to API linters and bytecode-compat tools that this class can change without notice in any release.

    • idle

      public boolean idle(String operationTag)
      Returns whether no scenario is indexed for the operation an operation tag names, so advice can return before reading its target. SCHEDULE_SUBMIT_PERIODIC is a SCHEDULE_SUBMIT; every other tag is an OperationType name (the file-channel transfers check their FILE_IO_* operation through beforeFileIo, not here).
      Parameters:
      operationTag - the tag
      Returns:
      true when no scenario is indexed for the operation
